Existing receipt -> never overwritten; cleanup result emitted to log before a new cleanup-receipt collision can fail.
not_claimed: No independent approval; root must assign another reviewer.
No CI worker/native/emulator shutdown proof; only Gradle stop and generated-directory scope in this draft.
No durable retention from merely leaving files on an ephemeral failed runner; upload failure remains a failed gate.
No Store operations, app source/game/protocol/persistence behavior changes, toolchain upgrades or signing changes.
workspace_actions: Only new task evidence and unapplied draft files; no tracked source writes, Git mutations, builds, test runs, publishing or credential use.
